claims.quote: Currently considered endemic to the Rakhine Yoma/Arakan mountains in Rakhine state, western Myanmar; this range forms a natural barrier which cuts the state off from the remainder of the country.
Danio feegradei was first described by the Indian ichthyologist S. L. Hora in 1937 from a single specimen originating from the Thandwe river in Myanmar (former Burma).
